description: The interval between two written notes. The number comes from the letters and the quality from the semitones, so C to E is a major third and C to Fb is a diminished fourth. Direction follows the written notes. Semitones is negative when the second note is lower. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-interval

title: Music Interval
